UNDER THE SURFACE

Nature is the reference.
Math is the medium.

An original procedural sketch, inspired by the luminous ASCII sea life in your reference. Every curve, ripple, and wandering arm is drawn in the browser.

01

A body of letters

Curved geometry, perspective, and moving highlights give every character a place in three-dimensional space.

@
02

A traveling ripple

Waves travel along the fins as the creature banks, turns, and swims toward and away from the light.

≈
03

A little independence

Arms reach, curl, and explore at their own pace. A startled creature gathers itself, sprays a current of black characters, then escapes.
